positioning: gofly provides a goctl-compatible migration path, not a full goctl replacement.

stages.summary: Migration-critical goctl api go and api format flags are covered by a runnable contract; --declare skips missing type declaration checks during formatting.
Migration-critical goctl rpc protoc flags are covered; external plugin names are forwarded only with explicit --allow-external-plugin opt-in.
Migration-critical goctl model options are covered by DDL and offline datasource replay fixtures while preserving gofly's model/repo layout boundary.
Real goctl output is compared against gofly output with version metadata and failure classes; layout differences and goctl generation errors remain report-only.
Realistic go-zero/goctl project fixtures must replay deterministically and compile under generated project smoke tests.

releaseChecklist: Run make goctl-compatibility-report-check to validate this index.
Run make goctl-generator-compat-check for generator, API flag, RPC protoc, model parity, API client, and zRPC compatibility.
Run make goctl-real-project-replay-check before promoting migration compatibility claims.
Treat oracle replay layout differences as report-only unless a future contract promotes byte-for-byte layout parity.

claimPolicy.allowed: Docs and release notes may claim goctl-compatible migration coverage only for stages with blocking gates or explicit report-only labels.
claimPolicy.forbidden: Docs and release notes must not claim full goctl replacement, byte-for-byte output parity, or default external plugin execution.
